public_comment.speaker: Mandy Gilman
public_comment.topic: Budget planning, level services funding, tri-board process
public_comment.quote: i thank both the chair and the superintendents for their comments, we have worked collaboratively for a long time over the last eight months with the rest of the town. there has been a lot of discussion about why there is not an option for level services funding, i feel strongly that the town, when they didn't endorse the override last year, asked the group of leaders in the town to get together and think about a long term plan. a long term plan is difficult in municipal finance, but the reason our budgets that are being represented include a few different things is because the goal of the tri board process was to think two to three years in advance, and i think that some of that is getting lost in the conversations.
